cases.sentence: В косой вечерней тени кулей, наваленных на платформе, Вронский в своем ___ и надвинутой шляпе, с руками в карманах, ходил, как зверь в клетке, на двадцати шагах быстро поворачиваясь.
cases.explain: «длинном пальто» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: In the slanting evening shadows cast by the baggage piled up on the platform, Vronsky in his long overcoat and slouch hat, with his hands in his pockets, strode up and down, like a wild beast in a cage, turning sharply after twenty paces. Sergey Ivanovitch fancied, as he approached him, that Vronsky saw him but was pretending not to see. This did not affect Sergey Ivanovitch in the slightest. He was above all personal considerations with Vronsky.

cases.sentence: В эту минуту Вронский в глазах Сергея Ивановича был ___ для великого дела, и Кознышев считал своим долгом поощрить его и одобрить.
cases.explain: «важный деятель» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: At that moment Sergey Ivanovitch looked upon Vronsky as a man taking an important part in a great cause, and Koznishev thought it his duty to encourage him and express his approval. He went up to him.

cases.sentence: В эту минуту Вронский в глазах Сергея Ивановича был важный деятель для ___, и Кознышев считал своим долгом поощрить его и одобрить.
cases.explain: «великого дела» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: At that moment Sergey Ivanovitch looked upon Vronsky as a man taking an important part in a great cause, and Koznishev thought it his duty to encourage him and express his approval. He went up to him.

cases.sentence: И так уж столько нападков на добровольцев, что такой человек, как вы, поднимает их в ___.
cases.explain: «общественном мнении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “Yes; but you might find it easier to get into relations, which are after all essential, with anyone prepared to see you. But that’s as you like. I was very glad to hear of your intention. There have been so many attacks made on the volunteers, and a man like you raises them in public estimation.”

cases.sentence: Дай вам бог успеха внешнего – и ___, – прибавил он и протянул руку.
cases.explain: «внутреннего мира» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “You will become another man, I predict,” said Sergey Ivanovitch, feeling touched. “To deliver one’s brother-men from bondage is an aim worth death and life. God grant you success outwardly—and inwardly peace,” he added, and he held out his hand. Vronsky warmly pressed his outstretched hand.

cases.sentence: Щемящая боль ___, наполнявшая слюною его рот, мешала ему говорить.
cases.explain: «крепкого зуба» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He could hardly speak for the throbbing ache in his strong teeth, that were like rows of ivory in his mouth. He was silent, and his eyes rested on the wheels of the tender, slowly and smoothly rolling along the rails.

cases.sentence: Да, разбиты в ___, но назавтра ожидается решительное сражение.
cases.explain: «третий раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “You have had no telegrams since yesterday’s? Yes, driven back for a third time, but a decisive engagement expected for tomorrow.”

cases.sentence: Да, разбиты в третий раз, но назавтра ожидается ___.
cases.explain: «решительное сражение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “You have had no telegrams since yesterday’s? Yes, driven back for a third time, but a decisive engagement expected for tomorrow.”

cases.sentence: И, поговорив еще о провозглашении королем Милана и об ___, которые это может иметь, они разошлись по своим вагонам после второго звонка.
cases.explain: «огромных последствиях» — after the preposition «об», for location or topic.
cases.translation: And after talking a little more of King Milan’s proclamation, and the immense effect it might have, they parted, going to their carriages on hearing the second bell.

cases.sentence: И, поговорив еще о провозглашении королем Милана и об огромных последствиях, которые это может иметь, они разошлись по своим вагонам после ___.
cases.explain: «второго звонка» — after the preposition «после», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: And after talking a little more of King Milan’s proclamation, and the immense effect it might have, they parted, going to their carriages on hearing the second bell.
